turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh from Nagpur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, my name is Ananya from the fraud monitoring team at your bank. We have detected a suspicious transaction of nine thousand five hundred rupees on your card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? Nine thousand five hundred? I did not do any such shopping today!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand. Was this transaction authorized by you or anyone in your family?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, no, not at all. Is my money gone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't worry, I have already blocked your card to prevent further loss. Do you have your card with you right now?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, it is in my wallet. What should I do now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Since the card is blocked, you just need to visit the branch for a replacement. I will send you the request details via SMS.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Will you need my account number or some password to fix this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No sir, please remember that our bank will never ask for your OTP, PIN, or CVV over the phone. We do not need any credentials from you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, okay. I was getting a bit nervous. Thank you for the help, beta.
